INSPLASH.Settings.Enabled.Name: Show splashes
INSPLASH.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Comic splash words after Invincible rolls (this client only).
INSPLASH.Settings.Others.Name: Show other players' rolls
INSPLASH.Settings.Others.Hint: Off: only splashes for rolls you made yourself.
INSPLASH.Settings.Placement.Name: Placement
INSPLASH.Settings.Placement.Hint: Over the roller's token on the map, or centered on screen. Falls back to the screen when the token is hidden or off-screen.
INSPLASH.Settings.Scale.Name: Splash size
INSPLASH.Settings.Hold.Name: Display time
INSPLASH.Settings.Hold.Hint: Multiplier of how long a splash stays. 1 = default.
INSPLASH.Settings.Effects.Name: Effects
INSPLASH.Settings.Effects.Hint: Rays, soft flash, shake and particles around strong results.
INSPLASH.Settings.Motion.Name: Motion
INSPLASH.Settings.Motion.Hint: Follow the system's reduced-motion setting, or force it.
INSPLASH.Settings.Fullscreen.Name: Fullscreen splash for rare successes
INSPLASH.Settings.Fullscreen.Hint: Rare results get a full-screen glow, rays and a giant word instead of a token-sized splash.
INSPLASH.Settings.FullFrom.Name: Fullscreen threshold
INSPLASH.Settings.FullFrom.Hint: Minimum effect power (0.4 to 1) for the full-screen version. 0.7 is roughly 'IMPOSSIBLE!' and above.
INSPLASH.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug log
INSPLASH.Settings.Debug.Hint: Writes the splash pipeline (and why a splash was skipped) to the browser console.
INSPLASH.Settings.Chat.Name: Chat badge
INSPLASH.Settings.Chat.Hint: Small rarity badge on roll cards in the chat log.
INSPLASH.Settings.Dry.Name: Narrator dry spell (rolls)
INSPLASH.Settings.Dry.Hint: World setting. After this many rolls without narration, the next success is narrated. 0 = off.
INSPLASH.Settings.K0.Name: Narrator threshold offset
INSPLASH.Settings.K0.Hint: World setting. +1 makes the narrator rarer, -1 more frequent.
INSPLASH.Settings.State.Name: Track character milestones
INSPLASH.Settings.State.Hint: World setting. Stores first success / first double / personal best in each hero's flags.
